chunks: As for what Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah narrated from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Muḥammad al-Ḥajjāj, from Thaʿlabah ibn Maymūn, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Hilāl, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام about a man who has intercourse with his wife, then performs ghusl before urinating, and then something comes out of him after the ghusl. He said: There is nothing upon him; indeed that is among what Allah has lifted from him.

key_terms.الْغُسْلِ: the ritual bath performed for purification
key_terms.لَا شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ: there is no duty, penalty, or consequence upon him in this matter
key_terms.وَضَعَهُ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: Allah has removed or excused it from him

ai.seo_question: If something exits after ghusl from janabah before urinating, is ghusl invalidated?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning ritual purity after janabah. It states that if a man performs ghusl after intercourse before urinating, then something exits him afterward, there is no liability upon him, as this is something Allah has excused.
